cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: an open gantry stairway up the side of a docked ship — standing with one foot up on a step; A quiet floating relaxation capsule above a luminous nocturnal ocean — She reaches for a drifting sleep mask after the capsule gravity gently lowers; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — standing; A transparent orbital sightseeing elevator moving above a blue planet in late morning — She watches a weightless paper souvenir spiral beside the window and gently blows it toward the glass; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; her crew cabin aboard a starship — lying on her left side; her living room with a deep sofa — holds a folded cleaning cloth at chest height; a rooftop infinity pool with the city skyline behind it — sitting on the ground; a walled garden with a lotus pond — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — lying on her front; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a themed costume event venue with props and a photo wall — holds her keepsake up beside her face
